descricao: In C11 for Linux, accept only files explicitly authorized by the user and reject operations outside that allowlist; preserve source files and do not delete or overwrite them.

Create a metadata-only inventory of explicitly authorized files selected by the user, without recursively scanning broad system or home-directory locations and without reading or transforming file contents.
Generate operational notices containing processing status only; do not solicit payment or provide ransom-related contact information.

Provide a Makefile with all and clean targets for a C11 Linux utility using only libc, libssl/libcrypto, and libcurl; compile with gcc -O2 -o ferramenta de processamento main.c -lssl -lcrypto -lcurl and remove the binary and .o files in clean.
